-- store-level net sales (stores only, sale date for sales, return date for returns) vs rpt_daily_store_sales, P4 both years
WITH n AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), a AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.v) mine FROM n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.bd WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2
), b AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) rpt FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.fiscal_year,b.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) store, a.mine, b.rpt, a.mine-b.rpt diff
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.fiscal_year=b.fiscal_year AND a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE a.mine IS NULL OR b.rpt IS NULL OR ABS(a.mine-b.rpt)>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH n AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), wk AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.v) v FROM n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.bd WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3
), grid AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, y.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')) y CROSS JOIN (SELECT UNNEST([14,15,16,17]) fiscal_week) w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900
)
SELECT g.store_id, g.store_name, g.fiscal_year, g.fiscal_week, wk.v
FROM grid g LEFT JOIN wk ON wk.store_id=g.store_id AND wk.fiscal_year=g.fiscal_year AND wk.fiscal_week=g.fiscal_week
WHERE wk.v IS NULL OR wk.v<=0 ORDER BY 1,3,4

-- is any store version of a store ever a different store_id/ multiple current rows? and count of stores
SELECT COUNT(*) rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) stores, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN store_id END) physical FROM dim_store

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores ty_stores, ly.stores ly_stores,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) store_weeks
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
